staff.name: Major Applewhite
staff.record: 2024: 7-6 with a Salute to Veterans Bowl win. 2025: 4-8.
staff.note: Year three after a 4-8 season, the point where Sun Belt schools have made changes (Bowden at ULM after three years, Clark at App State after a 5-6 year). At 4-3 with five left, two more wins means a bowl and should settle it. He calls plays himself, so the offense is his too. A P4 coordinator job is the only realistic way out, and that is unlikely after 2025.

staff.name: Todd Orlando
staff.record: FBS coordinator since 2005 (Texas, USC, Houston, USF).
staff.note: First year. Coordinators with his resume tend to move after one or two seasons when a bigger program calls, as he has done before. His future is also tied to Applewhite's: a head coaching change usually turns over the staff.

staff.name: Jason Washington
staff.note: Kept through the 2026 staff overhaul and given the co-coordinator title, which signals the head coach wants him in place.

staff.name: Richie Riley
staff.record: 152-106. 2024-25 Sun Belt regular-season title and NIT. 2025-26: 21-11.
staff.note: Eight straight seasons at .500 or better and two 20-win years in a row. The new extension makes him hard to pry loose, but a title-winning mid-major coach draws calls every March. A rebuilt roster (10 newcomers) is this season's test.

history.summary: Since the 2022 season, 13 Sun Belt football head coaching jobs have opened: 8 when a coach was hired away and 5 when a coach was fired or pushed out. Winners leave (Cignetti, Sumrall, Chadwell, Chesney); coaches who are fired had at least three seasons first.
